summary.intent: Update the callisto repo's changeset handling in a worktree (changeset-set): run a script that modifies changesets, and add a missing 'why' requirement to the AGENTS.md changeset rule.
summary.outcome: A changeset script was run and .changeset/changelog-grouped-layout.md was modified. AGENTS.md was edited to add the 'why' requirement, and a verify.sh check was run to confirm PASS/FAIL, though the transcript does not show the results.

repo: Callisto uses a .changeset directory for changesets, and AGENTS.md contains rules governing how changesets should be written.
Work is done in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/changeset-set under the callisto project.
A verify.sh script takes a worktree path and emits PASS/FAIL lines used to validate changes.
workflow: Helper scripts are kept in a separate jobs/tmp directory rather than in the repo, and Python is run with -I (isolated mode) to avoid loading code from the current directory.
Counting files in .changeset (ls | wc -l) is used as a quick sanity check after a bulk changeset edit.
Verification output is filtered with grep -E 'PASS|FAIL' to surface only the results.

open_items: The verify.sh PASS/FAIL results are not shown in the transcript, so it is unconfirmed whether all checks passed.
